simple.meaning: אַדְמֹנִי (ʼadmônîy) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, 1 Samuel, beginning at Genesis 25:25. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as kingship.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows אַדְמֹנִי through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: אַדְמֹנִי (ʼadmônîy) / H132 is tracked through Genesis 25:25, 1 Samuel 16:12, 1 Samuel 17:42. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

structuredEvidence.definition: reddish (of the hair or the complexion)

firstOccurrence.englishText: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

majorEvents.label: Naming
majorEvents.evidenceText: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

timeline.evidenceText: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.
He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. Yahweh said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”
When the Philistine looked around, and saw David, he disdained him; for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and had a good looking face.
